genes.name: HLA Class II DP Beta 1
genes.function: Antigen presentation to CD4+ T cells via MHC class II
genes.ssc_evidence: HLA-DPB1 alleles (especially DPB1*13:01 and DPB1*09:01) are among the strongest genetic risk factors for SSc. Part of the extended MHC class II association signal distinct from HLA-DRB1.

genes.name: Signal Transducer and Activator of Transcription 4
genes.function: Mediates IL-12 and type I IFN signaling; promotes Th1 and Th17 differentiation
genes.ssc_evidence: rs7574865 and rs3821236 variants significantly associated with SSc (OR 1.3-1.4). STAT4 drives Th1/Th17 polarization and is a shared autoimmune risk locus across SSc, SLE, and RA.

genes.name: Interferon Regulatory Factor 5
genes.function: Transcription factor driving type I IFN and proinflammatory cytokine expression via TLR-MyD88 pathway
genes.ssc_evidence: IRF5 rs2004640 and rs10488631 variants strongly associated with SSc (OR 1.3-1.5). IRF5 drives the type I interferon signature observed in SSc peripheral blood and skin.

genes.name: TNF Alpha Induced Protein 3 (A20)
genes.function: Ubiquitin-editing enzyme that negatively regulates NF-κB signaling downstream of TNF, TLR, and NLR receptors
genes.ssc_evidence: TNFAIP3 polymorphisms associated with SSc (OR 1.3). A20 deficiency leads to unchecked NF-κB activation, promoting fibroblast activation and myofibroblast differentiation in SSc skin.

genes.name: B Cell Scaffold Protein with Ankyrin Repeats 1
genes.function: Scaffold protein modulating BCR-induced calcium mobilization and B cell signaling
genes.ssc_evidence: BANK1 rs10516487 and rs3733197 variants associated with SSc, particularly the diffuse cutaneous subtype. Dysregulated BANK1 promotes B cell hyperresponsiveness and autoantibody production.

genes.name: B Lymphoid Tyrosine Kinase
genes.function: Src family kinase involved in B cell receptor signaling and B cell tolerance
genes.ssc_evidence: BLK rs13277113 and rs2736340 promoter variants associated with reduced BLK expression in SSc (OR 1.3). Altered BCR signaling thresholds contribute to loss of B cell tolerance.

genes.name: CD247 (CD3ζ Chain / TCR Zeta)
genes.function: Key signaling subunit of the T cell receptor complex; transduces TCR activation signals via ITAM motifs
genes.ssc_evidence: CD247 rs2056626 variant is a confirmed SSc risk locus (OR 1.3). Reduced CD3ζ expression in SSc T cells correlates with TCR signaling defects and Treg dysfunction.

genes.name: TNFAIP3 Interacting Protein 1 (ABIN-1)
genes.function: NF-κB inhibitor that cooperates with A20 (TNFAIP3) to deubiquitinate signaling intermediates downstream of TNF and TLR receptors
genes.ssc_evidence: TNIP1 rs2233287 variant associated with SSc (OR 1.2). TNIP1 deficiency impairs A20-mediated NF-κB suppression, promoting persistent inflammatory signaling in fibroblasts and immune cells.

genes.name: Deoxyribonuclease 1 Like 3
genes.function: Secreted DNase that degrades extracellular DNA from apoptotic cells and neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs), preventing autoantigen accumulation
genes.ssc_evidence: DNASE1L3 loss-of-function variants associated with SSc (OR 1.8). Impaired DNA degradation leads to accumulation of extracellular DNA triggering TLR9-mediated type I IFN and inflammatory responses.

genes.name: Protein Tyrosine Phosphatase N22 (LYP)
genes.function: Negative regulator of T cell receptor and B cell receptor signaling
genes.ssc_evidence: PTPN22 R620W (rs2476601) gain-of-function variant associated with SSc (OR 1.3). Alters TCR/BCR signaling thresholds and Treg function, shared risk across multiple autoimmune diseases.

genes.name: Interferon Regulatory Factor 8
genes.function: Transcription factor regulating myeloid cell development and type I IFN responses
genes.ssc_evidence: IRF8 rs11642873 variant associated with SSc (OR 1.2). IRF8 cooperates with IRF5 in driving the type I IFN signature, a hallmark of SSc pathogenesis.

genes.name: Interleukin-12 Subunit Alpha (p35)
genes.function: Subunit of IL-12 (p35/p40) and IL-35; drives Th1 polarization and IFN-γ production
genes.ssc_evidence: IL12A polymorphisms associated with SSc (OR 1.2). IL-12 promotes Th1 differentiation and contributes to the inflammatory phase preceding fibrosis.

genes.name: Toll-Like Receptor 2
genes.function: Pattern recognition receptor recognizing bacterial lipoproteins and endogenous damage-associated molecular patterns (DAMPs)
genes.ssc_evidence: TLR2 polymorphisms associated with SSc (OR 1.3). TLR2 is overexpressed in SSc skin fibroblasts and monocytes, where TLR2 ligation by DAMPs drives profibrotic TGF-β and IL-6 production.

genes.name: TNF Superfamily Member 4 (OX40 Ligand / CD252)
genes.function: Costimulatory ligand expressed on APCs; binds OX40 (CD134) on activated T cells to enhance survival and effector function
genes.ssc_evidence: TNFSF4 rs2205960 variant associated with SSc (OR 1.3). OX40L-OX40 costimulation promotes T cell survival and memory, sustaining autoimmune T cell responses.

genes.name: Interleukin-21
genes.function: Pleiotropic cytokine driving Tfh differentiation, B cell activation, and plasma cell generation
genes.ssc_evidence: IL21 polymorphisms associated with SSc (OR 1.2). IL-21 promotes Tfh-mediated B cell help, germinal center formation, and autoantibody production, linking T cell and B cell dysregulation in SSc.

genes.name: Peroxisome Proliferator-Activated Receptor Gamma
genes.function: Nuclear receptor regulating adipogenesis and exerting antifibrotic effects by antagonizing TGF-β/SMAD signaling in fibroblasts
genes.ssc_evidence: PPARG polymorphisms associated with SSc (OR 1.2). PPARγ deficiency in SSc fibroblasts contributes to unchecked TGF-β-driven myofibroblast differentiation and collagen deposition.

genes.name: Fc Gamma Receptor IIB (CD32B)
genes.function: Inhibitory IgG Fc receptor on B cells providing negative feedback via ITIM-mediated SHIP/SHP-1 recruitment
genes.ssc_evidence: FCGR2B I232T (rs1050501) polymorphism impairs inhibitory function on B cells (OR 1.3). Reduced BCR inhibition contributes to B cell hyperactivation and autoantibody production in SSc.

genes.name: Transforming Growth Factor Beta 1
genes.function: Master profibrotic cytokine driving fibroblast activation, myofibroblast differentiation (α-SMA expression), and extracellular matrix deposition (collagen, fibronectin)
genes.ssc_evidence: TGFB1 promoter polymorphisms (rs1800469, -509C>T) associated with SSc, especially dcSSc with pulmonary fibrosis (OR 1.4). TGF-β1 is the central fibrogenic mediator in SSc; its sustained activation drives skin and lung fibrosis.
